assets.prompt: Match the supplied game UI reference and preserve one shared visual system. Players are small children who cannot read: no lettering, labels or numerals. The original two tall posts become workbench side rails. No blue gems: small amber gems. Keep the original parchment and question recess unchanged.

assets.name: fist-pair
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a sprite sheet containing exactly TWO aligned states of ONE friendly fantasy game fist icon, matching the polished painted storybook RPG sword reference. A compact brown leather adventurer glove clenched into a fist, side/front three-quarter view with knuckles visibly curled, simple golden wrist cuff, no weapon, no forearm, no aggression or face. LEFT neutral; RIGHT the identical object with only warm gold edge light and a few compact sparks. Identical silhouette, pose, scale and placement in equal square cells, both states generated together. Transparent background, generous clear padding, no clipped glow, no cast shadow, no ambient scene. No lettering or numerals. Players are small children: the silhouette must immediately read as a fist. Only the icons: no complete button, no frame or labels. Runtime frame, text, hit area, disabled state and animation will be separate stable layers. Canonical frame will be reused, not generated per button. States will be normalized with one shared crop to identical transparent canvases and cross-faded without moving the root.
